title: Concentration sum below one
statement: Let $n$ be a positive integer, let $s$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $L,\delta>0$. If $4nL^2/\delta^2\le s$, then $2^n\bigl(2\exp(-s(\delta/L)^2/2)\bigr)<1$.
replaced: Let $n>0$ and $s\ge0$ be integers and $L,\delta>0$ be real numbers with $4nL^2/\delta^2\le s$. Then $2^n\bigl(2\exp(-s(\delta/L)^2/2)\bigr)<1$.
